channel.title: The Grant Desk - Audio, Sound & Music, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Audio, Sound & Music, weekly digest. Released weekly: each Sunday's drop carries one entry per grant added in the week before it (Sunday to Saturday). A call that closes before its drop goes out is not sent; the website lists those.

item.title: 100 Screams: Open Call for Screamers (worldwide, participatory)
item.description: Nguyen Hoang Gia Bao (independent artist) · deadline 31 Dec 2026 · No cash award; a participatory open call. Contributions become part of a 100-hour sound work and spatial installation.

item.title: Schlossmediale Call for Art Residency 2027 (Schloss Werdenberg, Switzerland)
item.description: Schlossmediale Werdenberg · deadline 18 Oct 2026 · CHF 4,000 grant per resident, plus CHF 1,000 for travel, transport and meals, up to CHF 1,000 for material costs, and accommodation in a shared house (individual rooms). Three residencies awarded.

item.title: La Scam: Bourses Brouillon d'un reve Sonore (Radio and Podcast Authors, rolling)
item.description: La Scam (Societe civile des auteurs multimedia) · deadline Rolling / undated · EUR 2,500 to EUR 6,000 per bourse, paid directly to the author 4 to 5 weeks after contract signing; over EUR 830,000 is distributed annually across all Brouillon d'un reve categories. No application fee.

item.title: Wave Farm: 2027 Research and Production Program (Transmission Art Residencies and Radio Art Fellowships, NY)
item.description: Wave Farm · deadline 01 Dec 2026 · USD 1,000 stipend for each 10-day residency; USD 2,000 for each two-month Radio Art Fellowship. No application fee.

item.title: Mid Atlantic Arts: USArtists International (FY28 round, up to USD 11,000)
item.description: Mid Atlantic Arts, with the National Endowment for the Arts and the Mellon Foundation · deadline 24 Feb 2027 · Grants of up to USD 11,000 toward eligible expenses, with a 1:1 cost match required. No application fee.

item.title: Braunschweig Projects 2027/28: Artistic Fellowships at HBK Braunschweig (Fine Arts and Sound Art)
item.description: Braunschweig University of Art (HBK Braunschweig), on behalf of the State of Lower Saxony · deadline 04 Oct 2026 · Stipend of EUR 1,600 per month for 12 months, plus a rent-free one-person studio apartment in Braunschweig (fellows pay EUR 250 per month towards incidental living costs) and an allowance for project and travel costs. 7 fellowships: 5 in fine arts and 2 in sound art. No application fee.

item.title: Futures of Listening x KNMI: Earth Immersion, Trembling Planet Residency
item.description: Futures of Listening (FIBER, 4DSOUND, Robin Koek, Art of Sound) in collaboration with KNMI, the Royal Netherlands Meteorological Institute · deadline 13 Sep 2026 · Total residency fee of EUR 7,125, calculated as 25 commissioned days at a day rate of EUR 285. Six of those 25 days can be spent at the 4DSOUND studio working with their team. Some additional financial support is available if needed, including material and travel costs, but these must be clearly defined and agreed before the residency starts. No application fee.

item.title: CTM Festival: Resynthesising the Traditional 2027 Artistic Lab (At the Extreme)
item.description: CTM Festival, co-curated by Stas Sharifulla · deadline 28 Sep 2026 · Travel budget of up to EUR 300 per person, plus accommodation and catering for the duration of the lab and a festival pass to CTM 2027 events. Visa fees are supported where required, and letters of invitation are provided for visa or funding applications. NO artist fee or stipend for the lab itself. Afterwards, up to two new works arising from the lab may be commissioned and presented at CTM Festival in January/February 2028. No application fee.

item.title: 1 new Audio, Sound & Music grant - week of 24 Aug 2026
item.description:
• INHABIT #16 and #17: Artist-in-Residence 2027 (Max Planck Institute for Empirical Aesthetics)
    https://www.aesthetics.mpg.de/en/research/inhabit-artist-in-residence.html
    Max Planck Institute for Empirical Aesthetics · deadline 01 Sep 2026 · Artist's fee of EUR 8,000 plus an accommodation fee of EUR 2,000, a production budget depending on the project, and travel costs to and within Frankfurt. Also included: realisation of the final project, collaborations with scientists, access to the institute's library, sound studio and scientific facilities, and curatorial support throughout the residency. No application fee.

item.title: 1 new Audio, Sound & Music grant - week of 17 Aug 2026
item.description:
• Residing Non-linear Technologies and Sonic Worldings (M-Cult x Titanik, Helsinki and Turku)
    https://www.titanik.fi/residency-open-call-residing-non-linear-technologies-and-sonic-worldings/
    Art and Media Culture Agency M-Cult (Helsinki) and Arte artists' association / Titanik gallery (Turku) · deadline 30 Aug 2026 · EUR 3,500 artist fee plus EUR 2,000 production budget, two months' accommodation split between Helsinki and Turku, and one return travel ticket from a Nordic-Baltic country. No application fee stated.

item.title: 3 new Audio, Sound & Music grants - week of 10 Aug 2026
item.description:
• University of Amsterdam: PhD, Protest and Political Speech in the Nordics 1930-1970 (Sound of Disagreement)
    https://www.academictransfer.com/en/jobs/362349/phd-position-on-protest-and-political-speech-in-the-nordics-1930-1970/
    University of Amsterdam (UvA), Faculty of Humanities, Department of European Studies · deadline 20 Aug 2026 · EUR 3,059 to 3,881 gross per month at 38 hours per week, on the Dutch university PhD scale, plus 8 percent holiday allowance and 8.3 percent year-end bonus. No application fee.
  • Ernst von Siemens Musikstiftung: Project Funding (October 2026 round)
    https://evs-musikstiftung.ch/en/project-funding/application/
    Ernst von Siemens Musikstiftung · deadline 01 Oct 2026 · No published minimum or maximum. Primarily covers artistic costs, not overheads. The Foundation explicitly will not fully fund a project, and requires at least one other institution to participate financially at a level similar to the amount requested, functioning as a de facto 1:1 match. No application fee.
  • Stichting NORMA: NORMA Fonds Project Grant (round 4, 2026)
    https://www.stichtingnorma.nl/norma-fonds/aanvragen/
    Stichting NORMA (collecting society for performing artists) · deadline 30 Oct 2026 · Maximum EUR 10,000 per project. Total project budget may not exceed EUR 150,000 and the applicant organisation's annual budget may not exceed EUR 500,000. At least 25 percent of the project budget must come from audience or box-office revenue. Performer fees must meet the 2026 wage norms of EUR 139 per rehearsal and EUR 340 per performance. No application fee.

item.title: 3 new Audio, Sound & Music grants - week of 03 Aug 2026
item.description:
• Berlinale Talents 2027 (Berlin International Film Festival)
    https://www.berlinale-talents.de/bt/page/c/apply
    Berlinale / Berlin International Film Festival · deadline 02 Sep 2026 · Free participation in the week-long professional program (Summit workshops, Talents Lab, Talent Project Market, industry networking). NO stipend; travel and accommodation are self-covered (national film institutes often fund this; Netherlands-based filmmakers can approach the Netherlands Film Fund). EUR 15 application service fee (EUR 10 early bird before 19 August 2026).
  • Berlin Senate: Arbeitsstipendium Bildende Kunst 2027 (Berlin residents only)
    https://www.berlin.de/sen/kultur/en/funding/funding-programmes/visual-arts/artikel.230092.en.php
    Berlin Senate Department for Culture and Social Cohesion · deadline 02 Sep 2026 · EUR 16,000 (8 months) or EUR 24,000 (12 months), paid as EUR 2,000 per month. No application fee.
  • Columbia Institute for Ideas and Imagination: Paris Fellowship 2027-28
    https://ideasimagination.columbia.edu/apply/applying-for-a-fellowship/
    Columbia University Institute for Ideas and Imagination · deadline 30 Sep 2026 · USD 75,000 stipend, plus housing at Reid Hall in Paris and office and research support, September 2027 to May 2028. No application fee.

item.title: 2 new Audio, Sound & Music grants - week of 27 Jul 2026
item.description:
• Klang Copenhagen Avantgarde Music Festival: Open Call 2027, MUSIC/MOVEMENT
    https://www.klang.dk/open-calls/opencall2027
    Klang - Copenhagen Avantgarde Music Festival · deadline 01 Sep 2026 · Klang aims to cover production costs and performer fees. Travel and accommodation are discussed case by case rather than guaranteed. No commission fee is offered, since the call seeks finished work rather than new creation. No application fee.
  • In Listening 2027: Call for Hybrid Radio/Live Works (CTM Festival, Berlin)
    https://www.ctm-festival.de/festival-2027/open-calls/in-listening-2027
    CTM Festival with Deutschlandfunk Kultur and ORF · deadline 06 Sep 2026 · Two selected works are each supported by a fee of EUR 6,000. CTM covers travel to Berlin and lodging during the production and festival periods; technical and staging costs for the CTM presentation (and possible ORF musikprotokoll presentation) are covered separately by arrangement. Research, creation and collaborator costs are the artist's own. Radio-production support (translations, voiceovers, studio time) can be provided by Deutschlandfunk Kultur upon discussion. No application fee.

item.title: 2 new Audio, Sound & Music grants - week of 20 Jul 2026
item.description:
• ZAMEK Artist Residency 2027 (ZAMEK Culture Centre, Poznan)
    https://ckzamek.pl/artykuly/14724-open-call-rezydencje-artystyczne-2027/
    ZAMEK Culture Centre (Centrum Kultury ZAMEK) · deadline 27 Jul 2026 · Accommodation in an apartment in the former imperial residence, studio access, a fee of PLN 6,000 gross per month (contract for specific work), a production budget of PLN 5,000 to 15,000 gross depending on length of stay and project, plus curatorial support and publicity. No application fee listed.
  • Creation and Production: Contemporary Music
    https://prohelvetia.ch/en/find-support/creation-and-production-contemporary-music
    Pro Helvetia (Swiss Arts Council) · deadline 01 Sep 2026 · Maximum CHF 25,000 (depending on overall project size). No application fee.

item.title: 1 new Audio, Sound & Music grant - week of 06 Jul 2026
item.description:
• National Gallery of Iceland: CUSP Artist Residency (Reykjavik 2027)
    https://www.listasafn.is/en/art/news-vasulka-stofa/
    National Gallery of Iceland (Listasafn Islands), CUSP project · deadline 03 Sep 2026 · Accommodation and working space for the residency; travel and subsistence stipend; an artist fee for collaborating in the open-lab/masterclass; and, depending on the artist's request and museum means, hardware and software for the working space. No application fee.

item.title: 2 new Audio, Sound & Music grants - week of 29 Jun 2026
item.description:
• Atheras: Nicosia Ludic Lab for Composers, Toyful Music Festival 2026
    https://on-the-move.org/news/atheras-nicosia-ludic-lab-composers-new-works-toyful-music-festival-2026-cyprus
    Atheras Peoples and Cultures · deadline 15 Jul 2026 · Full financial support: travel, shared accommodation in central Nicosia, and daily allowance. Rehearsal space and full production support provided; final live concert recorded (video and audio) for documentation and international visibility.
  • Sonic Connections Open Call 2027 (Villa Filanda Antonini)
    https://www.vfa.art/events/sonic-connections-open-call-2027/
    Villa Filanda Antonini (VFA) · deadline 19 Jul 2026 · Fully funded residency covering mentoring, accommodation, travel costs, production costs, and a daily salary, plus a EUR 1,000 residency stipend.
